fusions.name: Stooping Dive
fusions.desc: A diving strike at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 10 damage, up to 2.2 times that at the full 8 tiles, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Takeoff Gust
fusions.desc: A downdraft from your takeoff that deals 3 wind damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Effortless Bound
fusions.desc: Carries you instantly to a point up to 9 tiles away, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Light Bones
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you have 8% wind resistance.
